config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of streets in and around old residential communities in Wuchang District, Wuhan (one of four directions at each point), not the paper's images. Residents rate each view on the six Place Pulse 2.0 perceptions, safe, beautiful, lively, wealthy, boring and depressing, on a five-point Likert scale, as in the local check by Guo, Xu, Lin & Li (2025, Scientific Reports): 220 residents (balanced by gender and age, over 70% living in Wuchang for more than five years) rated 180 images, about 12 ratings per image, used to fine-tune and validate a perception model. Differences from the original study: (1) 10 random views per participant; (2) the sampling area was drawn by us around the old communities of central Wuchang; (3) years living in Wuchang are recorded.

paper.title: Deep learning assessment of street spatial quality in old residential communities of Wuchang, Wuhan, China
